`interface ITextMarkup`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.font.markup` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [ITextMarkup.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/font/markup/ITextMarkup.java)

A markup tag that a text reads inline, such as a bold or a color tag, which changes the style of the characters after it.

## Description

Register it with [`TextMarkup.register`](/reference/text/textmarkup/#TextMarkup-method-register) so that every text reads it, or give it to one style with [`TextInfo.markups`](/reference/text/textinfo/#TextInfo-property-markups).
A tag takes no width, is never cut when a line wraps, and stays in the text that modifiers see untouched.

## Method details

<a id="ITextMarkup-method-parse"></a>

### parse

`int parse(String text, int index, TextStyle style)` <span class="joid-qualifier">abstract</span>

JOID calls it at each character of a text while it lays it out or measures it, on the render thread.
When a tag of yours starts at `index`, change `style` (weight, color, font, effects; [`TextStyle.reset`](/reference/text/textstyle/#TextStyle-method-reset) for a closing tag) and return the number of characters of the tag; otherwise return `0`.
